moneyIntro: Optional. The app works in units; with these it also shows money.
deviceOnly: These values stay on this device. They never leave this browser and are never sent anywhere.
currencyHint: Just a label shown next to amounts.
bankrollUnset: Without a bankroll and a unit value, everything is shown in units.
moneyCleared: Bankroll and unit cleared from this device.
presetsIntro: Filter combinations saved from the Explorer or the Simulator.
cacheNote: The script keeps its read of the sheet for {minutes} minutes so it does not reload it on every visit, so refreshing can bring data up to {minutes} minutes old.

redactionsNote.one: The script hid {n} money-like text in the notes.
redactionsNote.other: The script hid {n} money-like texts in the notes.

aboutBody: Bets Tracker shows the “Bets Tracker with Claude” sheet read-only: it never writes to the sheet and keeps no money from the sheet.
appUpToDate: Up to date: this is the latest version.
appUpdate: A new version is ready: reload to use it.
appOffline: No offline mode at this address (development).
scriptCurrent: Up to date: the sheet runs the script version the app expects.
scriptDifferent: The sheet is running a different version of the feed script.
scriptMissing: The sheet is running a different version of the feed script: one from before the script reported its version.
scriptStillValid: The data still shows normally: an older script also serves a valid feed with no money in it.
scriptWhatToDo: What to do: copy Feed.gs from the repository over the Feed file of the sheet's Apps Script project, run btFeedSelfTest and deploy a new version of the existing deployment (Deploy › Manage deployments › edit › New version). The /exec URL stays the same.
scriptCacheNote: After deploying, the script can keep serving its cached copy for up to {minutes} minutes. Refresh the data after that and check here again.
